title: Query VM Termination Events
description: Deterministically queries GCP Audit Logs (Compute Engine System Activity) for host errors, terminations, preemptions, and automated repairs, scoped to a specific workload's nodes. Provides the raw evidence that [[ai-hw-analyzer]] interprets. Scoping is mandatory: an unscoped query over a busy project returns dozens of unrelated preemptions belonging to other workloads, which is the standard route to a false 'this workload was preempted' conclusion.
instruction: gcloud logging read 'logName:"cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fsystem_event" AND timestamp>="${start}" AND timestamp<="${end}" AND (protoPayload.methodName:"compute.instances.hostError" OR protoPayload.methodName:"compute.instances.terminate" OR protoPayload.methodName:"compute.instances.terminateOnHostMaintenance" OR protoPayload.methodName:"compute.instances.preempted" OR protoPayload.methodName:"compute.instances.repair.recreateInstance" OR protoPayload.methodName:"compute.instances.guestTerminate") AND (${node_filter})' --project=${project_id} --limit=${limit} --order=ASC --format=json > ${output_file}; python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('${output_file}')); print(json.dumps({'event_count': len(d), 'methods': sorted({e.get('protoPayload',{}).get('methodName','?') for e in d}), 'nodes': sorted({e.get('protoPayload',{}).get('resourceName','?').split('/')[-1] for e in d}), 'output_file': '${output_file}', 'verdict_hint': 'No VM Termination' if not d else 'VM/host events found'}, indent=2))"

start.description: Window start, UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Include lead-in before the first disruption.

node_filter.description: REQUIRED scoping clause restricting results to this workload's nodes. Use the `node_filter_clause` field emitted by [[resolve-workload-nodes]] verbatim, e.g. protoPayload.resourceName:"gke-tpu-node-a" OR protoPayload.resourceName:"gke-tpu-node-b".
